publicationTitle: 2021 21st ACIS International Winter Conference on Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Networking and Parallel/Distributed Computing (SNPD-Winter)
abstract: In order to find ways to secure competitive advantage and realize sustainable growth for small and medium-sized manufacturing firms, this study conducted a path analysis from strategic orientation to management performance. Analysis results showed that customer orientation has a positive effect on dynamic competence. Also, technology orientation showed a positive effect on dynamic competence, with the exception of resource acquisition capability. In addition, dynamic competence showed a positive effect on management performance, with the exception of resource acquisition capability having insignificant effects on management performance. Finally, the mediating effect of dynamic competence was proven. In accordance to the results, to secure competitive advantage and realize sustainable growth for small and medium-sized manufacturing firms, it is important to establish a strategic orientations and expand and reinforce dynamic competence. This study provides managerial implications by understanding the competitive environment of small and medium-sized manufacturing firms and based on this, presenting strategic directions for enhancing the competitiveness of small and medium-sized manufacturing firms.

articleTitle: A Study On Sentiment Analysis Combine Matrix Factorization For Ratting Product In Vietnamese
publicationTitle: 2021 21st ACIS International Winter Conference on Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Networking and Parallel/Distributed Computing (SNPD-Winter)
abstract: In recent years, hybrid system using different kinds of input data into a unified model become an interesting research. According to it, traditional rating data (user x item) can be re-structured by setting additional dimensions (mood, time, user's location...of textual data). Meanwhile, Vietnamese sentiment analysis problem is also restricted by non-expansion feature of data input. Stem from these issues, this research proposed a featured combine model by integrating matrix factorization in collaborative filtering and sentiment analysis in text mining to predict rating user. With experimental results, the author proves that proposed model achieve better results in accuracy and is feasible to develop as the future direction research.

articleTitle: A Study on the Improvement of User-centered Public Service
publicationTitle: 2021 21st ACIS International Winter Conference on Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Networking and Parallel/Distributed Computing (SNPD-Winter)
abstract: Service design not only helps to establish the policy and service for the consumer deliberation, but also can improve the efficiency of the process through integrated design by linking policy makers and providers. In this study, we analyze the best practices of `The Civic Participatory Service Design Team' operated in Korea for in-depth improvement of public service design, and provide basic data for successful utilization of public service design by deriving characteristics and improvement plans.

Author Keywords: The Civic Participatory Service Design Team

articleTitle: Further Observation to Investigate Tendency of Obtaining Potential Appropriate Respondents to Questions at Q&A Sites with Expansion of Categories
publicationTitle: 2021 21st ACIS International Winter Conference on Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Networking and Parallel/Distributed Computing (SNPD-Winter)
abstract: In order to eliminate mismatches between the intentions of questioners and respondents of Question and Answer (Q&A) sites, nine factors of impressions for statements have experimentally been obtained. Factor scores have been then estimated by using the feature values of statements. So far, the possibility of detecting respondents who can appropriately answer a newly posted question has been established for limited several categories e.g. Auction, PC, etc. It has been shown that the distance and the appearance times could lead to selecting users who are able to appropriately answer a question. In order to inspect these tendencies, the objectivity of this paper is to investigate if any further tendency of introducing proper respondents to a questioner could be observed by analyzing the Q&A statements other than those already used and expanding their categories. As a result of analysis, the tendencies that particular several users are inclined to appear in each category has been verified. Quantitative evaluation has also shown the outstanding tendency of answer statements.
